title: Index Friends
tagline: Index Friends are elevating DeFi investing! Investors explore top portfolios, while strategists profit from expertise through dynamic NFTs that grow in value with portfolio success.
description: Index Friends is a DeFi platform that merges traditional investment paradigms with the innovative world of NFTs. Upon connecting their wallets, investors are presented with top-performing investment portfolios, curated to align with the platform's quality guidelines. These strategies, similar to index funds, are passively managed by skilled strategists. But here's where Index Friends truly innovates: each strategist's approach is encapsulated within a tradable NFT, with its value intrinsically tied to the performance of the underlying portfolio. Strategists not only gain from their portfolio management prowess but can also monetize their proven expertise by trading these NFTs. As these digital tokens appreciate based on the attached portfolio's success, they can traded, introducing a novel market dynamic. With an eco-friendly stance, using the carbon-neutral Celo network, and integrating technologies like WalletConnect, Uniswap, QuickNode, and IPFS, Index Friends offers investors and strategists alike a prosperous, secure, and dynamic investment landscape.
how_its_made: We employ WalletConnect for user login to our platform, which is deployed on Celo. Trading operations are executed via Uniswap's decentralized exchange protocols. RPC connections are facilitated through Quicknode infrastructure. Our NFT assets are persisted in the InterPlanetary File System (IPFS). Furthermore, our NFTs incorporate artistic assets sourced from Nouns DAO.
